$comment: One-time, content-pinned exceptions to the fork/upstream path boundary (phicad/git-workflow.md, 'Fork/upstream path boundary'). Each entry admits exactly one blob at one upstream path; any later change to that file is forbidden again. Read by phicad/bin/check_fork_boundary.py. Drop an entry once `phicad sync` brings upstream's own version of the fix.

exceptions.reason: kicad-cli segfaulted at exit (139) after `sch erc` on a schematic with no sibling .kicad_pro on Linux: the empty-path default project's PROJECT_FILE outlived the eeschema kiface's ERC_ITEM statics because PGM_KICAD::OnPgmExit() unloaded only GetOpenProjects(). The fix unloads that project too (11 lines).
exceptions.authorized_by: fork maintainer, 2026-09-22: one fix, not a general relaxation
exceptions.upstream: the buggy loop is upstream code (f938b2358d); to be submitted to gitlab.com/kicad/code/kicad and this entry removed when `phicad sync` returns upstream's version

exceptions.reason: regression test for the fix above: test_sch_erc_standalone_schematic_exits_cleanly (fails with exit 139 on the previous binary, passes with the fix).
